metadata.protocol: repl-from-stdin NDJSON: Initialize, Evaluate, GetSeed; one process, isolated initialization per case
metadata.policy: Go follows the TypeScript reference for callback eagerness, shared closure captures, seeded sampling, traversal, domain limits and diagnostics; modulo-by-zero deliberately returns a structured QNT503. Raw Rust values, callback diagnostics and call traces are preserved.

cases.name: factory-shared-parameters
cases.source: { def f(x)=(y)=>x+y; val fs=List(f(10),f(20)); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) }
cases.reason: Both references reuse factory parameter slots: invoking the second factory changes the first closure capture too, yielding List(21,22).

cases.name: factory-lazy-value-capture
cases.source: { def f(x)={ val z=x*2; (y)=>z+y }; val fs=List(f(10),f(20)); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) }
cases.reason: Both references share the factory parameter through its lazy local value, yielding List(41,42).

cases.name: factory-via-fold
cases.source: { def f(x)=List((y)=>x+y); val fs=List(10,20).foldl(List(),(a,x)=>a.append(f(x).head())); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) }
cases.reason: Both references retain shared factory parameter captures through fold-created closures, yielding List(21,22).
